findings.title: Call to undefined no-argument isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added/available in UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). No no-arg method is defined in the shown class hierarchy, so this will not compile.

findings.title: Passkey conditional UI is disabled whenever the context user is null
findings.body: UsernamePasswordForm.isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns false when user is null, and it is used in authenticate() and challenge() to decide whether to fill WebAuthn conditional UI data. On first login, and after a failed username/password attempt before context.setUser() has been called, context.getUser() is null. The previous code filled WebAuthn data in the null-user case; the new code does not. This breaks passkey autofill/discoverable-key login for new sessions and passkey retry after a failed first login.

findings.title: Conditional passkey suppresses authenticator list but not shouldDisplayAuthenticators
findings.body: WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator overrides shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators() to false to avoid showing passkey authenticator lists, but it does not override shouldDisplayAuthenticators(). During re-authentication with a known user, WebAuthnAuthenticator.fillContextForm() will still set SHOULD_DISPLAY_AUTHENTICATORS to true while not setting ALLOWED_AUTHENTICATORS. This can produce an inconsistent or empty authenticator UI, contrary to the stated intent.
